user.title: Sign in to SmartHQ
user.description:
Enter the SmartHQ (GE Appliances) account you use in the SmartHQ mobile app.

If your account has two-factor authentication (2FA) turned on, a verification code will be emailed to you and requested on the next screen — so keep your email handy.

data_description.username: The email address for your SmartHQ account.
data_description.password: Your SmartHQ account password (this is not your Home Assistant password).
data_description.region: Choose US for North America or EU for Europe.

reauth.title: Reconnect SmartHQ
reauth.description:
Home Assistant can no longer sign in to SmartHQ, so your appliances are unavailable. Re-enter your password below to reconnect.

If two-factor authentication (2FA) is turned on, a verification code will be emailed to you and requested on the next screen. After you finish, Home Assistant stays signed in and won't ask for a code again unless the login stops working.

data_description.username: The email address for your SmartHQ account.
data_description.password: Your SmartHQ account password (this is not your Home Assistant password).
data_description.region: Choose US for North America or EU for Europe.

mfa.title: Enter your verification code
mfa.description:
SmartHQ emailed a verification code to the address on your account. Enter it below to finish signing in.

The code expires after a few minutes. If it expired or never arrived, leave the code blank, tick **Resend code**, and submit to get a new one.

data_description.mfa_code: The one-time code from the SmartHQ email.
data_description.resend_code: Leave the code blank and tick this to email a fresh code.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid authentication provided, please check credentials
error.invalid_mfa_code: Invalid or expired verification code, please try again
error.mfa_required: Multi-factor authentication is required; please complete MFA in the SmartHQ app and try again
error.terms_required: Terms of service acceptance is required; please accept the terms in the SmartHQ app and try again

init.title: GE Home Options
init.description:
Choose how entity IDs and names are derived. Both modes fall back to the other identifier when the preferred value is unavailable.

- serial_or_mac (Serial number, fallback MAC): entity IDs use the serial when valid, otherwise the MAC. If serial availability changes (restart, bad ERD, non-printable serial), entity IDs can change and may create duplicate entities.
- mac_or_serial (MAC address, fallback serial): entity IDs use the MAC when valid, otherwise the serial. More stable across restarts, but MAC-based names are harder to recognize in the UI.

Changing this setting reloads the integration and recomputes all entity unique IDs and names. Automations and dashboards referencing old entity IDs may need updating, and switching modes can leave duplicate/orphaned entities that require manual cleanup.

data_description.device_identifier: serial_or_mac = serial with MAC fallback (default for existing installs); mac_or_serial = MAC with serial fallback (default for new installs)
